provenance_gate_ruling.the_pre_audit_is_not_the_basis: The dispatching session reported 'inference blocks present in ALL SEVEN artifacts'. Read against the bytes that statement is IMPRECISE: six artifacts carry a filled in-text block or stanza, and od1_and_gate_redesign_report.md carries a Provenance POINTER plus manifest digest binding instead. The Coordinator records the discrepancy rather than adopting the summary, because a gate ruling taken on another agent's say-so is not a ruling. The outcome is unchanged — the gate is satisfied — but it is satisfied for the reason given below, not for the reason offered.
reasoning: 1. WHAT AMENDMENT 002 ACTUALLY REQUIRES OF EACH ARTIFACT CLASS. The amendment's `changes` clause imposes the comment-block stanza on 'every DECLARED SOURCE-CODE artifact', and the artifact_provenance list on 'the covering manifest of each producer task', binding 'every declared source path to its SHA-256'. It imposes NO new requirement on prose reports. Both source-code artifacts of TASK-802 and the single source-code artifact of TASK-801 carry the stanza, and both covering manifests carry the list with an explicit coverage assertion. On the amendment's own terms the added gate is met by both producers with nothing missing.

2. THE BASE FILLED-BLOCK REQUIREMENT IS DISCHARGEABLE BY CONTENT BINDING, AND THAT IS SETTLED CAMPAIGN LAW, NOT A CONVENIENCE READING. The TASK-20260731-704 ruling (reasoning item 4) held that the gate's purpose is provenance ATTRIBUTABILITY and that it is met by hash binding rather than by proximity; the TASK-20260731-705 validator ACCEPTED that basis after recomputing the digests itself. Amendment 002 explicitly did NOT overturn that ruling — its `what_this_amendment_is_not` states it 'does NOT assert that provenance in BATCH-002 was defective. It was verified sound by content.' It added a cheap redundancy for source code. Applying to a BATCH-003 report a STRICTER reading of the base requirement than the one that governed BATCH-002, without an amendment saying so, would be a post-hoc criterion change of exactly the kind amendment 002 exists to refuse.

3. THE BINDING HERE IS STRICTLY STRONGER THAN THE ONE ALREADY ACCEPTED. In BATCH-002 the accepted discharge was a digest sitting in a manifest field (control_source_sha256, artifacts.implementation_sha256) that a reader had to recognize as a provenance binding. Here od1_gate701c_results.json names the report path explicitly in a list called artifact_provenance, states its digest, states its kind, states comment_block_inference_stanza: false rather than concealing it, and asserts covered_by_this_manifest_inference_block: true in terms. The report in turn points back by name. A reader holding either file alone can answer 'what produced this' and can detect an edit. The invariant amendment 002 was written to make cheap is, for this artifact, cheap.

4. THE PROPORTIONATE RESPONSE TO THE RESIDUAL IS A DEFECT, NOT A RETURN. Returning TASK-20260801-801 as incomplete would discard, over a missing paragraph in a prose file whose provenance is fully attributable, the batch's only exponent-relevant work product and the pre-registered gate run that DEC-20260731-013 made a precondition for any future reject_scoped. That is not enforcement, it is disproportion. The residual is recorded as D-803-1 at severity low, classed as Coordinator-side drafting, and referred to TASK-20260801-804 for an independent ruling that may overturn this one.

5. WHAT IS NOT RULED. This ruling does not validate the CONTENT of any inference block. model_verified is false in all seven. TASK-801 additionally records that `python3 -m orchestration.adapter doctor --probe` WAS executed (exit 0) and verified NOTHING — every backend reported an unset API key or a refused connection — which is a stronger and more honest record than BATCH-002's 'not run', and which makes explicit that every resolved_model_id in this campaign is unverified configuration. It also does not treat the recorded fallback as independence: producers, validator and Coordinator all resolve to the same model under this harness, so BATCH-003 independence is in SESSION only, never in MODEL, per amendment 0137a051.

purpose.endorsement: NONE. ARCHIVING ENDORSES NOTHING AND RANKS NOTHING. This receipt confers no evidence strength, no hypothesis status, no closure, no novelty verdict, no promotion fitness and no validity on any measurement, derivation, instrument or claim inside the seven artifacts. It does not decide whether Proposition 801-1 follows, whether the redesigned gate genuinely discriminates, whether the negated ingredient is genuinely NECESSARY, whether ER-6 is closed, whether the widened control is non-vacuous, or whether ER-7 and ER-8 bound anything. source_outcomes.reported_outcome: Diameter computed exactly; the OD-1 extension is stated as a proposition WITH its residual declared decisive; the redesigned gate RAN and returned a DISCRIMINATING reading.
producer_reported_summary: DIAMETER, EXACT. The directed 1020-node (lambda,k) graph has diameter d = 30 on the forward graph and 30 on the reverse graph, radius 30, and EVERY one of the 1020 nodes has eccentricity exactly 30 — a degenerate eccentricity distribution, not merely a max. Strong connectivity was re-confirmed three ways independently of BATCH-002's verify_derivation.py claim C11. G^2 has diameter 16, carries a self-loop at every node, and has covering number n* = 15.

THE EXTENSION FOLLOWS BUT DOES NOT CLOSE THE HOLE, and the producer says so in those terms. Proposition 801-1, with a four-lemma derivation: a layer-dependent family whose pi^(0) is non-injective has pi^(L) constant for every L >= 2 + 2n* = 32 interfaces. Corollary 801-2: a genuinely lossy layer-dependent family survives at most 31 interfaces. The departure from PROP-701-I Step 3 — the single point at which round-independence was consumed — is located exactly. The constant is BETTER than OD-1's own guess (~32 against ~60).

RESIDUAL R1 IS DECISIVE AND IS STATED AS DECISIVE. Families surviving <= 31 interfaces are entirely untouched, and ALL in-scope round counts 3-7 fall strictly inside that untouched window. R2-R5 are named, including the two D-705-5 scope holes and the interface-vs-round modelling convention.
THE REDESIGNED GATE DISCRIMINATES: yes. Pre-registration of predicted readings and VOID conditions was on disk at 08:05:45Z; the gate ran 08:05:55Z-08:06:09Z.

reading: 1. THEY CHANGE WHAT A GREEN CERTIFIES. THEY DO NOT CHANGE WHAT WAS RECORDED. A green from this mutation control has always been a statement about the instrument's SENSITIVITY to the faults actually enumerated, in the coverage cells actually generated. ER-7 and ER-8 show that the green additionally presupposes a NON-EVASIVE module — one that does not read its own __name__ and does not write to a shared runner path. Neither route was available to, or taken by, any BATCH-002 or BATCH-003 mutant: the mutants are committed, readable, and contain neither construction. So every scored observation stands exactly as recorded, and the producer is right that nothing is retroactively invalidated. What narrows is the INFERENCE a reader may draw FROM a green, not the green.

2. THE PRECISE NARROWING. Before ER-7/ER-8, the defensible reading of a green was roughly: 'the control fires on faults of the enumerated shapes within the generated cells, and a mutant cannot manufacture a detection.' After, the defensible reading is: 'the control fires on faults of the enumerated shapes within the generated cells, PROVIDED the module under test does not detect that it is under test and does not tamper with sibling subprocesses; and the isolation property that a mutant cannot manufacture a detection is FALSE as a general statement, though no scored mutant exercised it.' The second clause is the part v2 asserted and v3 falsified.

3. THE DIRECTION OF THE THREAT WAS ALREADY KNOWN, AND THAT MATTERS FOR HOW MUCH IS NEW. ER-5 already recorded, OPEN, that a mutant can hide its own fault, producing false negatives. ER-7 is a sharper and more automatic instance of exactly that class — the module is not merely able to hide a fault, it is handed a reliable oracle telling it WHEN to hide. ER-8 is genuinely new in kind, because it crosses process boundaries and defeats an isolation property that was affirmatively CLAIMED rather than merely hoped for. On this reading ER-8 is the more serious finding and ER-7 is the more reliably exploitable one.

4. THE STRUCTURAL LESSON, WHICH IS THE PART WORTH CARRYING. ER-6 was the H-3 failure shape recurring inside the repair for H-3. ER-7 and ER-8 are the ER-6 shape recurring inside the repair for ER-6. Three iterations of a repair generating the next instance of its own failure class is a strong prior AGAINST treating the class of false-green escapes as closable by enumeration, and a reason to treat any future green from this instrument as bounded rather than as clearing a condition. Whether DEC-20260731-011's certification condition can be discharged AT ALL by an instrument of this design, or whether that condition needs restating in terms this instrument can meet, is a real question — and it is TASK-20260801-805's, not this task's.

5. WHAT THIS READING DOES NOT SAY. It does not say the BATCH-002 green is void, that EV-AES-002 needs amending, that ER-6 is not closed on its axis, or that the BATCH-003 pass verdict on the pristine module is unreliable. It says a green certifies less than v2 claimed for it, and that the certificate should be written down at its true strength when TASK-20260801-805 prices it.
